policy: Shared PLC text spacing and footer ink; frozen independently fitted scan poses. 33 training / 123 validation cards. Rules validation was reused after rejecting a font/reflow trial with large wrapping regressions; this is repeated validation. Existing font sizes, wording and line breaks retained. Regions exclude panel bevels and unrelated ink. Regional similarity scores are not whole-card correctness percentages.
limitations: Some printed font sizes and line breaks remain different, notably Groundbreaker and Dust Corona.
Rule spacing decreases the score on 27 held-out cards; retain them in the review queue.
Gold pinlines, P/T plate shape/material and color outliers require further review.
Six rejected scans and three split cards are excluded from calibrated scores.
